leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a TypeScript interface to define the shape of context values
Initialize a context with typed default values using createContext
Configure a provider component with typed props for the context
Apply the typed context provider to wrap components in a component tree
Manipulate context values through typed provider props
Integrate the typed context into functional components using useContext
Update component implementations to consume typed context values
lessonTitle: Type context values and provider props
